issues.description: readFileSync on every external stack frame with no caching
issues.detail: getSourceMap fires on every frame during stack parsing. For each external file it does existsSync + readFileSync + a regex scan of the whole file via convert-source-map. A failing test with a deep stack across many node_modules files will hammer the disk. Memoize per-file map result (including negative results) keyed by absolute path.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes resolution semantics; needs a test
issues.detail: Flipping from resolve(s, from) to resolve(from, '..', s) is the actual fix, but the diff ships no unit test for DecodedMap.resolvedSources. The snapshot change in stacktraces.test.ts is the only evidence. For a sourcemap resolver used across the codebase, add a direct test covering absolute sources, relative sources, and sources with leading slash so the next regression is caught at the unit, not via a snapshot diff.

issues.description: Silent swallow of read/parse errors hides real problems
issues.detail: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' for missing files, and extractSourcemapFromFile has no try/catch around convert-source-map. A malformed inline sourcemap on an external file will throw mid stack-parse and blow up error reporting itself. Wrap in try/catch, log under debug, and return undefined so the original stack survives.

issues.description: Dead local binding and pointless parens
issues.detail: const result = extractSourcemapFromFile(...); return result is just return extractSourcemapFromFile(...). And the outer parens around the second convertSourceMap.fromMapFileSource(...) call add nothing. Trim to one line each. Small thing, but this file gets read a lot.

issues.description: Adding convert-source-map when @jridgewell/* is already in the tree
issues.detail: Vitest already depends on @jridgewell/trace-mapping and friends, which can extract inline/file sourcemaps without a second library. Pulling in convert-source-map plus @types/convert-source-map for a ~30-line helper is extra surface area and a second sourcemap parser in the same package. Worth checking whether the existing jridgewell stack can do this before landing a new dep.

issues.description: Comment says 'fetch module' but doesn't explain the invariant
issues.detail: The comment 'Module node exists due to Vitest fetch module, but transformResult should be empty for external modules' is the load-bearing assumption of the whole patch. If transformResult is ever populated for an externalized module (SSR edge cases, plugin transforms), the branch is skipped and the fix silently doesn't apply. State the invariant explicitly and ideally assert/test it.

review.summary: The core one-line fix in DecodedMap is plausible and the snapshot delta proves it does something useful, but the patch is doing three things in one diff: fix resolve(), add a new dep, and bolt sourcemap extraction onto the reporter path. NEEDS-WORK. Biggest concerns: no caching on a function called per stack frame, silent error swallowing inside the error-reporting path itself, and a new sourcemap library when @jridgewell is already in the tree. Add a direct unit test for resolvedSources rather than relying on the e2e snapshot to catch regressions. Tone of the fix is right; the engineering around it is sloppier than it needs to be.
